html:
G'oya

Reysda ikki shahar bor va ikkalasi ham cities ga ishora qiladi. Shuning uchun cities ni ikki marta ulaymiz, har safar boshqa alias bilan: a jo'nash shahri, b yetib borish shahri.

Yechim

SELECT f.code, a.name AS from_city, b.name AS to_city
FROM flights f
JOIN cities a ON a.id = f.from_city_id
JOIN cities b ON b.id = f.to_city_id

Har bir nusxa o'z ustuniga bog'langan: a from_city_id ga, b to_city_id ga. Aylanma reysda ikkala nusxa bitta shaharni topadi. Bu muammo emas: reys baribir bitta qator bo'lib chiqadi.

Tuzoqlar

Bitta JOIN va OR. Har bir reys ikki qatorga bo'linadi: birida jo'nash shahri, ikkinchisida yetib borish shahri, va ikkala ustunda bir xil nom turadi. Namunada 4 reys 8 qatorga aylanadi:

Noto'g'riSELECT f.code, c.name AS from_city, c.name AS to_city
FROM flights f
JOIN cities c ON c.id = f.from_city_id OR c.id = f.to_city_id

Aliaslarni adashtirish ham oson. b.name ni from_city o'rniga qo'ysangiz, namunada HY101 Toshkentdan Samarqandga emas, Samarqanddan Toshkentga uchib qoladi.
